AppRoleAssignments.Reason: Reads signInActivity of the guest accounts to determine the last sign-in
Reads the transitive members of the ignore groups
Reads /sites/root to derive the SharePoint admin center URL
Reads /organization to show the tenant display name in the report
Sends the report email via Send-RjReportEmail when EmailTo is configured
Enumerates all site collections and OneDrives with Get-PnPTenantSite, reads the user information list of every site with Get-PnPUser and removes the guests with Remove-PnPUser

ManualPermissions: SharePoint Online: grant 'Sites.FullControl.All' application permission on the Office 365 SharePoint Online API (AppId 00000003-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000) to the Automation account's system-assigned managed identity. This SharePoint app-only grant cannot be made through the standard Entra app-role-assignment automation used for Microsoft Graph and must be assigned manually per tenant.

Azure Storage Account: 'Storage Account Contributor' role for the Automation Account's managed identity on the target storage account - the upload retrieves the account keys via listKeys (only required when CreateDownloadLink is used)
